One technical library

Section titled “One technical library”

The website renders the maintained Markdown under Docs/ directly into native documentation pages. Search, sidebars, page outlines, code copy controls, and previous/next navigation work locally on this site; GitHub remains the source and contribution workflow, not the reading experience.

Kéire is pre-1.0

The documentation describes implemented repository behavior and calls out incomplete production-readiness work without invented dates or guarantees. Start with the Production Readiness Review when evaluating Kéire for a release.
